name: esg-commitment-audit
description: Evidence-first ESG and climate commitment auditing through the ICS hosted API.

interface.shortDescription: Audit ESG and climate commitments with traceable evidence
interface.longDescription: Extract written ESG and climate commitments, apply the ICS CRV framework, and surface missing baselines, boundaries, owners, review mechanisms, remedies, and page evidence. This marketplace bundle uses the authorized hosted API and requires an ICS API key.
defaultPrompt: Audit this ESG or climate report and show commitment structure gaps with traceable evidence.
